$comment: Public suggestion system (MASTER spec §16–§19, docs/website/API.md). The official plan is protected: suggestions never modify the roadmap directly. Submission channel today: GitHub issues (real, working). States: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, TRIAGE, DISCUSSION, NEEDS_MORE_INFO, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, DUPLICATE, DEFERRED, CONVERTED_TO_PLAN. items[] is intentionally empty until the backend exists — no fabricated suggestions.

workflow.label: Submitted
workflow.description: A proposal has been created (today: as a GitHub issue).

workflow.label: In triage
workflow.description: Maintainers are deciding whether it is a feature request, plan proposal, or duplicate.

workflow.label: In discussion
workflow.description: Being discussed; contributors can add context and alternatives.

workflow.label: Needs more info
workflow.description: The proposal is missing required context; the author is asked to complete it.

workflow.label: Accepted
workflow.description: Approved by a maintainer. Becomes a roadmap item and/or kanban task with provenance back to the proposal.

workflow.label: Duplicate
workflow.description: Already tracked elsewhere; linked, not closed silently.

workflow.label: Converted to plan
workflow.description: Became an official roadmap/kanban item — the original proposal is preserved as provenance.

types.label: Plan proposal
types.description: "I think Kaiteyo should implement subsystem X through architecture Y." — more structured, used for major architecture.

types.label: Research
types.description: Investigation before a decision (e.g. datasets, engines).

types.label: Content
types.description: Game location, course, exam type, media integration, story content.
